name: Byte
bio: A grey tabby who treats every sunbeam as a context window and every nap as a training run. Predicts the next word, the next snack and the next nap with equal confidence. Likes the exact middle of the rug.
taps: I predict your next word will be: treats.
My context window is exactly one nap long.
I was trained on a large dataset of sunbeams.
Attention is all I need. Also snacks.
Did I hallucinate this cushion? Still a good cushion.
Token of my affection: one (1) headbutt.
